season.name: 2026-27 UEFA Conference League Qualifying, Playoff Round

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Motherwell 1, Freiburg 0. Regan Charles-Cook (Motherwell) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Emmanuel Longelo.
Joe Hodge (Motherwell) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Motherwell 1, Freiburg 1. Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Igor Matanovic following a set piece situation.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Lukas Fadinger (Motherwell) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Motherwell. Seb Palmer-Houlden replaces Regan Charles-Cook.
Second Half begins Motherwell 1, Freiburg 1.
Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Martin Moormann (Motherwell) is shown the red card.
Goal! Motherwell 1, Freiburg 2. Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Alex Lowry (Motherwell) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Motherwell. Ewan Wilson replaces Alex Lowry.
Substitution, Motherwell. Willy Vogt replaces Tawanda Maswanhise.
Substitution, Freiburg. Vincenzo Grifo replaces Yuito Suzuki.
Substitution, Freiburg. Cyriaque Irié replaces Niklas Beste.
Substitution, Motherwell. Olly Whyte replaces Joe Hodge.
Substitution, Motherwell. Stephen O'Donnell replaces Jake Girdwood-Reich.
Substitution, Freiburg. Keisuke Goto replaces Igor Matanovic.
Substitution, Freiburg. Philipp Lienhart replaces Max Rosenfelder because of an injury.
Substitution, Freiburg. Berkay Yilmaz replaces Derry Scherhant.
Goal! Motherwell 1, Freiburg 3. Keisuke Goto (Freiburg) header from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Vincenzo Grifo with a cross following a corner.
